risk_note: RV2 (catalog, content config save path). GET /v1/search/hot-words (F-PROD-03, D10-419 (a); BR-ATTR-29 carried in the ledger comment per #1748): search.hot_words and search.keyword_routes (registered by B1-05l #1790, default []) are returned in configured order, empty lists when unset, read anonymously; no search statistics. Saving either key through the existing config-item admin path runs this task's checks, merged in app.module with payout's existing check (payout's behaviour unchanged): hot words need non-empty text within the contract limits; keyword routes need a keyword and a target whose route and params are checked against contracts/routes.json; ExternalPage URLs are parsed with URL and refused on a union host (external_page.union_host_block on unless set false) or when they carry user info; any invalid item refuses the whole value, rollback included. getSearchHotWords is no longer planned; codegen and the route generators were rerun. No money moves. The full verify on the test machine was stopped at 3600 s in unrelated long property tests; this task's save.int / read.int and all other stages passed; per D10-319 the required CI decides. Codex was unavailable until 11-02, so the rule tests and reviews ran on fresh independent Claude contexts (approvals id 36).
